Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image1 ACTUAL AI EDIT TARGET is our single source-phase15 five-heart sprite, native1254x1254. Image2 actual source phase15 controls relative arrangement. Image3 established inventory heart identity only. Images4/5 style only.
Redraw the five jewels NATURALLY at about80percent of their current physical size around the same centres. Keep exactly FIVE, same rose-jade/gold identity, same fine painting and five separate transparent gaps. Keep the upper three jewel centres stable. Raise only the LOWER TWO heart centres by about80px compared with target. Their smaller size gives clear gaps, do NOT overlap any jewels. This fixes the current too-tall outer envelope [69,221,1187,977]. New complete visible alpha envelope should beabout1055wide x600high, intrinsic ratio51:29=1.75862, not counting empty canvas. Current target jewels are too big and low; do not leave the old envelope unchanged.
All geometry correction must be freshly hand-painted by image generation, no flat squashing/stretching. Hearts remain plump and wide, their contour and gold cloud-curl intact but smaller. Five whole natural jewels only, no extra dots, light trails, ring, rope, fog, halo, grey/gold field, shadow, text or UI. Entire exterior, centre and every inter-jewel gap must have real alpha=0. The target already has safe empty alpha; preserve it, don't introduce translucent background haze. Original source head attachment/timing remain unknown. Same canvas framing is fine, with ample empty space; only actual jewel envelope ratio counts. Highest host-provided image quality target.
